permission.title: Tool approval required
permission.body: The assistant wants to run {{tool}}. Approve this action?

scope.bash: "Allow for this session" auto-approves commands made only of:
scope.tool: "Allow for this session" auto-approves every {{tool}} call this session
scope.serverTool: "Allow for this session" auto-approves {{subject}} for the rest of the session
scope.directory: "Allow for this session" auto-approves {{tool}} for files directly in {{dir}}

rememberScope.bash: Future conversations on this device run these without asking:
rememberScope.tool: Future conversations on this device run every {{tool}} call without asking
rememberScope.serverTool: Future conversations on this device run {{subject}} without asking
rememberScope.directory: Future conversations on this device may edit and write files directly in {{dir}} without asking

warning.security: Security check flagged this command. Session approvals do not cover it.
warning.unparsed: This command could not be fully analyzed. Review it carefully.
warning.network: This command contacts a remote host over the network.
warning.privateNetwork: This fetch targets your local machine or a private network.
warning.sensitiveRead: This file often contains secrets such as exported API keys. Approve only if the agent needs it.
warning.outsideDeletion: This permanently deletes files that already exist outside the workspace. Approve only if you asked for this deletion.
warning.sensitiveWrite: This writes to a protected location: stored credentials, a startup item, or agent or app settings. Approve only if you asked for this change.
warning.sandbox: The sandbox blocked this command: it wrote outside the workspace or touched a protected file.
warning.sandboxNetwork: The sandbox blocked this command's network access.
warning.sandboxCredentials: The sandbox blocked access to your stored credentials (keychain or credential helper).

escalation.title: Command blocked by the sandbox
escalation.body: You approved this command, but the OS sandbox stopped part of it. Choose whether to let it escape the sandbox.

permission.escalateBody: Tool calls (file writes, terminal commands, MCP) will run without confirmation and without the sandbox. Only the built-in blocklist of catastrophic commands (such as deleting the whole disk) still applies.

mode.autoHint: Runs commands in a sandbox, asks before escaping
mode.yoloHint: Run everything without asking or a sandbox

welcome.title: What can I help with?
welcome.subtitle: Ask anything. ChatShell can search the web, read your files, and get things done on your computer.
welcome.pickModelBody: Pick a model from the menu at the bottom of the message box.
welcome.noModelTitle: Connect an AI model to start
welcome.noModelBody: Add an API key from a service like OpenAI or OpenRouter, or use a model running on your own computer with Ollama.

search.title: Search the web
search.prompt: What are the most important news stories today? Summarize the top 5 and include the sources.

files.title: Tidy up a folder
files.prompt: Look through my Downloads folder and suggest a simple way to organize it. Don't move or delete anything yet.

explain.title: Explain something
explain.prompt: Explain how compound interest works in simple terms, with a small example.
